# IT Space

> IT Space is a technology consulting and cybersecurity company headquartered in Tanger, Morocco. We serve businesses across North Africa and beyond with cutting-edge IT solutions that drive digital transformation, operational efficiency, and security.

IT Space was founded in Tanger and has built a reputation as the go-to technology partner in the Maghreb region, combining deep local market knowledge with internationally certified expertise.

## Services

- [IT Consulting](/en/services/consulting): Strategic technology guidance, IT infrastructure audits, technology roadmapping, vendor management, and change management for organizations across North Africa.
- [Cybersecurity](/en/services/security): Threat assessment, penetration testing, SOC monitoring 24/7, ISO 27001 compliance implementation, and incident response & recovery.
- [Cloud Solutions](/en/services/cloud): Cloud migration (AWS, Azure, GCP), multi-cloud strategy, managed cloud services, and disaster recovery solutions.
- [Digital Transformation](/en/services/digital): Business process automation (BPA/RPA), ERP & CRM implementation (SAP, Odoo, Salesforce), business intelligence, and customer experience design.
- [Software Development](/en/services/software): Custom web applications, mobile apps (iOS/Android), API design & integration, and legacy system modernization.
- [AI & Data Solutions](/en/services/ai-data): AI strategy & roadmap, machine learning models, data engineering pipelines, and generative AI integration (GPT-4, Claude, Mistral).

## Company

- Founded: Tanger, Morocco
- Expertise: IT Consulting, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Digital Transformation, Software Development, AI & Data
- Team: Certified engineers and consultants with 10+ years experience
- Track record: 50+ projects delivered, 100+ satisfied clients, 99% satisfaction rate
- Coverage: Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Senegal and remote clients in Europe and the Middle East
